name: Japan alert: false identities, payment routing, and location concealment

attribution.legal_posture: Official foreign-government, police, CERT, sanctions, or security-service guidance/assessment

caveats: Avoid retaining or republishing applicant identity documents, network selectors, or contact details.
Facial recognition and visual person-matching are outside the review.
The August 2025 Japanese alert is a later official revision of guidance also published in March 2024; the dates distinguish the versions.
The indicators are contextual screening signals with benign explanations; nationality, identity, intent, and DPRK affiliation require corroboration.

statements: The official NPA-hosted August 27, 2025 revision updates Japan's company warning after the March 2024 alert. It details false nationality or identity, forged and borrowed identity documents, third-party platform and payment accounts, VPN/remote-desktop concealment, compensation routing, and contextual platform indicators. It does not support the previously recorded AI-generated-face or deepfake-interview claims, which were removed.
